## TL;DR

Addressed the round 1 review findings for the Checks mobile header. Mobile links now have 44px minimum targets, and the Plan tab's Refresh button spans the full two-column action grid with the same minimum height. Declared review captures cover 390×844 and 320×844 layouts and a dark-theme populated history view.

## Work and rationale

The first implementation placed Help and Edit plan in a two-column mobile grid and gave them 42px minimum height. Review identified that 42px was short of the repo's 44px mobile convention. I increased the action-link minimum height to 44px. The Plan tab also conditionally adds Refresh to the same actions container; it previously occupied only one grid column and retained its small button height. I added a page-specific class to that control and made it span both columns with a 44px minimum height at phone widths. Desktop layout and behavior are unchanged because both adjustments are scoped to the existing narrow viewport media query.

The shot declarations now pin the viewport size and theme. The Plan route is captured at 390×844 in light mode to show the three-action case. The populated Runs route uses the `checks:timings` fixture at 320×844 in light mode and 390×844 in dark mode. Each declaration highlights the affected header or actions. These are declarations for RepoOS's review capture pipeline; I have not claimed that the captures have already been rendered or visually inspected in this session.

## Approaches tried

For the orphaned Refresh action, making it full-width keeps the help links as paired controls and gives the standalone control a deliberate row. Replacing the small ghost button with a different button treatment would have changed more of the desktop Plan flow than needed, so I preserved its existing variant and raised its mobile target size through the scoped class.

## Challenges and blockers

The existing CSS hides page subtitles globally on phones, while Checks overrides that behavior in its scoped stylesheet. The review changes do not alter that interaction: only the mobile action dimensions and grid placement changed. The task metadata is managed by RepoOS, so shot declarations were updated with `repoos update`; task status remains under RepoOS control.

## Key learnings

Conditional controls need to be considered in the layout grid even when they appear only on one tab. Shared action containers can make the common two-link case look correct while leaving an occasional third action stranded. Explicitly spanning that control also provides a stable full-width touch target. Review shots are more useful when their viewport and theme are pinned, especially when the acceptance criteria name specific phone widths and color modes.
